metadata.percentile_method: linear interpolation, equivalent to NumPy default percentile method

metric: executor.execute wall-clock latency in milliseconds; includes OVS mutation, post-mutation verification, safety verification and live connectivity check; excludes topology startup and synthetic approval preparation
postconditions: All 5 runs: executor success, change verified, safety verified, connectivity verified, both expected drop rules present, post-transaction ping loss 0%.
caveats: Synthetic approval record was prepared before the timer; this is not human approval latency.
Repeated transactions were executed on a fresh isolated Mininet/OVS topology each run.
One additional full-harness attempt failed on a separate access-port rejection assertion and is not included in the latency distribution; see 2026-10-30_8349bbe_real_ovs_latency_sample_01.txt.
